answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using zero-knowledge proof-of-personhood nullifiers. Each agent submits a proof tied to a unique human credential and deterministic nullifier, making duplicate claims crystal clear to the registry without exposing the sponsor. Attackers incur the scarce cost of a distinct verified human per identity, curbing an automated Sybil spiral. However, black markets can still lease real credentials behind a violet veil of off-chain collusion.
